<div class="ds-markdown ds-assistant-message-main-content">
<h2><span>1k+ 小数据集 SFT + KTO 微调与评测完整攻略</span></h2>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>基于 Qwen3.5-9B + RTX 4090D (24GB) 实战经验总结</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2><span>一、项目概述</span></h2>
<h3><span>1.1 目标</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用 1,000+ 条<span> 高质量训练数据，通过 SFT + KTO<span> 两阶段微调，让模型学会从需求描述中生成结构化测试用例（JSON 格式）<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>1.2 最终成果（测试集评测）</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>指标</span></th><th><span>结果</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>格式正确率</span></td>
<td>100%</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>语义相似度（DeepSeek）</span></td>
<td>91.1/100</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>采纳率（≥80分）</span></td>
<td>86.0%</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>召回率</span></td>
<td>86.14%</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>准确率</span></td>
<td>85.68%</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>F1</span></td>
<td>0.859</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>隐藏需求覆盖</span></td>
<td>73.7%</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>✅ 结论<span>：模型在未训练需求上表现出色，具备直接部署价值。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>二、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3><span>2.1 硬件配置</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>组件</span></th><th><span>规格</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>GPU</span></td>
<td><span>NVIDIA RTX 4090D (24GB) × 1</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>CPU</span></td>
<td><span>16 vCPU Intel Xeon Platinum 8352S</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>内存</span></td>
<td><span>62GB</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>系统盘</span></td>
<td><span>30GB（⚠️ 仅放系统，模型和数据放数据盘）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>数据盘</span></td>
<td><span>50GB SSD</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h3><span>2.2 软件版本</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>

</thead>

<tr>
<td><span>CUDA</span></td>
<td><span>12.8</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>PyTorch</span></td>
<td><span>2.10.0</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Transformers</span></td>
<td><span>5.3.0</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>ms-swift</span></td>
<td><span>4.4.2</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>vLLM</span></td>
<td><span>0.17.1（如兼容性问题可改用 Transformers 直接推理）</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h3><span>2.3 环境安装</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment"># 安装 ms-swift
pip <span class="token function">install ms-swift

<span class="token comment"># 评测依赖（本地/云实例）
pip <span class="token function">install openai sentence-transformers scikit-learn tqdm</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>2.4 ⚠️ 磁盘空间管理（关键）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment"># 模型文件约 18-20GB，务必设置缓存到数据盘
<span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">MODELSCOPE_CACHE<span class="token operator">=/your_data_disk/.cache/modelscope
<span class="token builtin class-name">export <span class="token assign-left variable">HF_HOME<span class="token operator">=/your_data_disk/.cache/huggingface
<span class="token function">mkdir <span class="token parameter variable">-p <span class="token variable">$MODELSCOPE_CACHE <span class="token variable">$HF_HOME</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">否则 30GB 系统盘会被模型下载撑爆，导致容器崩溃。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2><span>三、数据准备（阶段0）</span></h2>
<h3><span>3.1 数据格式</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token property">"messages"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token punctuation">[
    <span class="token punctuation">{<span class="token property">"role"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"system"<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token property">"content"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"你的任务是帮我生成功能测试用例"<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">,
    <span class="token punctuation">{<span class="token property">"role"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"user"<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token property">"content"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"模块：XXX，功能点：XXX..."<span class="token punctuation">}<span class="token punctuation">,
    <span class="token punctuation">{<span class="token property">"role"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"assistant"<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token property">"content"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token string">"[{\"testpoint\": \"...\", \"priority\": \"..\", \"steps\": \"...\", \"expectation\": \"...\"}]"<span class="token punctuation">}
  <span class="token punctuation">]
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>3.2 数据拆分（⚠️ 关键）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment"># 9:1 拆分
训练集: ~900 条 → 用于 SFT + KTO 训练
测试集: ~100 条 → 永久封印，仅用于最终评估</span></pre>
</div>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">测试集绝不参与任何训练或生成过程，否则泛化评估失效。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2><span>四、阶段一：SFT（监督微调）</span></h2>
<h3><span>4.1 核心理念</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>让模型学会遵循指令、输出 JSON 格式<span>。此阶段模型可能生成质量一般的测试用例，没关系——这正是阶段二（KTO）要解决的。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>4.2 参数配置（1k 小数据集专属）</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>值</span></th><th><span>说明</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>num_train_epochs</code></td>
<td>1 ~ 1.5</td>
<td><span>小数据集跑多轮必过拟合</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>learning_rate</code></td>
<td>1e-5</td>
<td><span>比常规略低</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>weight_decay</code></td>
<td>0.1</td>
<td><span>强正则化防过拟合</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>per_device_train_batch_size</code></td>
<td>1</td>
<td><span>9B模型+24GB显存，显存紧张</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>gradient_accumulation_steps</code></td>
<td>8</td>
<td><span>等效 batch_size = 8</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>max_length</code></td>
<td>2048</td>
<td><span>足够覆盖测试用例长度</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>max_new_tokens</code></td>
<td>1536</td>
<td><span>避免截断</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>bf16</code></td>
<td><span>true</span></td>
<td><span>节省显存</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h3><span>4.3 训练命令（ms-swift）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
swift sft \
    </span>--model /path/to/Qwen3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">9B \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tuner_type lora \
    </span>--dataset /path/to/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sft_train.json \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">torch_dtype bfloat16 \
    </span>--num_train_epochs <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--per_device_train_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--learning_rate 1e-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--weight_decay <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--warmup_ratio <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--lora_rank <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--lora_alpha <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--target_modules all-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">linear \
    </span>--gradient_accumulation_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--save_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--save_total_limit <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--logging_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--max_length <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2048</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--output_dir ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output_sft_v1 \
    </span>--dataloader_num_workers <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3><span>4.4 检查点选择</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>训练完成后取 最后一个 checkpoint<span>（如 <code>checkpoint-134</code><span>）。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用 <code>swift export</code><span> 合并 LoRA 权重为完整模型：</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">swift export \
    </span>--model /path/to/Qwen3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">9B \
    </span>--adapters ./output_sft_v1/checkpoint-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">134</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--output_dir ./<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_merged \
    </span>--merge_lora <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span></pre>
</div>

<h2><span>五、阶段二：KTO 数据准备（动态打标）</span></h2>
<h3><span>5.1 核心理念</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用 SFT 模型对训练集<span>重新生成回答，对比生成结果与标准答案的相似度，自动打上 <code>label: true/false</code><span> 标签——这就是 KTO 所需的“好/坏”样本。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>5.2 ⚠️ 关键原则</span></h3>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">必须用 SFT 模型自己生成，不能用更强的 API 模型替换！<span><span><br></span></span></p>

</blockquote>
<h3><span>5.3 生成参数（高温制造差异）</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>值</span></th><th><span>说明</span></th></tr>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>temperature</code></td>
<td>0.9</td>
<td><span>强制模型产生变异，暴露弱点</span></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>max_new_tokens</code></td>
<td>1536</td>
<td><span>完整生成</span></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>top_p</code></td>
<td><span>0.9</span></td>
<td><span>适度多样化</span></td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>

</div>
<h3><span>5.4 评分与打标</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">使用deepseek推理模型对原回答和SFT模型回答进行打分设置分数阈值，打标签false</p>
<div class="ne-card-container" data-width="746.6666870117188" data-height="218.33334350585938">
<div class="ne-code ne-codeblock ne-code-viewer code-fz14 ne-codeblock-height-limit" data-codeblock-mode="python">
<div class="ne-codeblock-inner">
<div class="cm-editor  ͼ1 ͼ2 ͼ4 ͼg ͼm">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<div class="cm-content" data-language="python">
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-variable">首先筛选json格式，若非json格式，打标签flase</span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-variable">若为json格式，进行语义相似度打分，设置阈值筛选flase评分标准：</span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">90<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">100 <span class="cm-variable">分：测试用例覆盖的核心功能点几乎完全一致，测试场景设计合理且相似</span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">80<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">89 <span class="cm-variable">分：核心功能点覆盖完整，测试场景设计基本一致</span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">70<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">79 <span class="cm-variable">分：主要功能点有覆盖，但测试场景设计有差异</span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">60<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">69 <span class="cm-variable">分：部分功能点有覆盖，测试场景设计差异较大</span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">50<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">59 <span class="cm-variable">分：仅有少量功能点重叠</span></span></span></span></span></div>
<div class="cm-line"><span class="cm-operator">- <span class="cm-number">0<span class="cm-operator">-<span class="cm-number">49 <span class="cm-variable">分：测试用例差异很大，几乎没有重叠</span></span></span></span></span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</li>

</ul>
<h3><span>5.5 数据输出格式</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token punctuation">{
  <span class="token property">"messages"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token punctuation">[...<span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token punctuation">,
  <span class="token property">"label"<span class="token operator">: <span class="token boolean">true   <span class="token comment">// 或 false
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>六、阶段三：KTO</span></h2>
<h3><span>6.1 核心理念</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用二元标签（好/坏）让模型更倾向于生成 true 样本的风格<span>，同时厌恶 false 样本中的错误模式<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>6.2 参数配置（1k 小数据集专属）</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>值</span></th><th><span>说明</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>num_train_epochs</code></td>
<td>2</td>
<td><span>KTO 收敛快</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>learning_rate</code></td>
<td>5e-5</td>
<td><span>比 SFT 低一个数量级</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">undesirable_weight</span></div>
</td>
<td>1.2</td>
<td><span>⚠️ 小数据集需加大奖惩力度！</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>per_device_train_batch_size</code></td>
<td><span>2</span></td>
<td><span>根据显存调整</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h3><span>6.3 训练命令（ms-swift）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
swift rlhf \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">rlhf_type kto \
    </span>--model /root/autodl-tmp/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model_merged \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">template qwen \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tuner_type lora \
    </span>--dataset <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/root/autodl-tmp/data/kto-train.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--load_from_cache_file <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--split_dataset_ratio <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.07</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--num_train_epochs <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--per_device_train_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--per_device_eval_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--learning_rate 5e-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--lora_rank <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--lora_alpha <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--target_modules all-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">linear \
    </span>--gradient_accumulation_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--eval_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--save_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--save_total_limit <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--logging_steps <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">output_dir output \
    </span>--warmup_ratio <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.05</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--dataloader_num_workers <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--dataset_num_proc <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--beta <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--undesirable_weight <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.2</span> </pre>
</div>
</div>

<h2><span>七、模型推理</span></h2>
<h3><span>7.1 方案选择</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>方案</span></th><th><span>速度</span></th><th><span>稳定性</span></th><th><span>推荐场景</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Transformers 直接推理</td>
<td><span>慢（~2-3小时/1000条）</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 高</span></td>
<td><span>小批量、稳定性优先</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>vLLM API 服务</td>
<td><span>快（~10-20分钟）</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 需环境兼容</span></td>
<td><span>大批量、生产环境</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h3><span>7.2 Transformers 推理命令</span></h3>
<p><span>使用之前准备好的未经训练的数据集进行推理，便于后续评测</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>查看官方推荐，设置参数 官方推荐使用以下采样参数组合进行生成： <br>　　通用任务的思考模式：temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0 <br>　　精确编码任务（如 WebDev）的思考模式：temperature=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=0.0, repetition_penalty=1.0 <br>　　通用任务的指令（或非思考）模式：temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0 <br>　　推理任务的指令（或非思考）模式：temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0 <br>请注意，不同推理框架对采样参数的支持情况可能有所不同。任务定位：属于“精确编码任务”
让模型从提问的需求中提取功能点并生成结构化的JSON数组，这本质上是信息提取 + 结构化输出
因此，参数设置如下：
temperature=0.1
top_p=0.95
top_k=20
min_p=0.0
presence_penalty=1.5
repetition_penalty=1.0</pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3><span>7.3 vLLM 推理（如果兼容）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token assign-left variable">CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES<span class="token operator">=<span class="token number">0 python <span class="token parameter variable">-m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server <span class="token punctuation">\
    <span class="token parameter variable">--model ./model_kto_final <span class="token punctuation">\
    --served-model-name testcase-generator <span class="token punctuation">\
    <span class="token parameter variable">--dtype bfloat16 <span class="token punctuation">\
    <span class="token parameter variable">--port <span class="token number">6006</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>八、评测体系</span></h2>
<h3><span>8.1 评测框架</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用 <code>eval_results.jsonl</code><span>（每条包含 <code>expected</code><span> 和 <code>actual</code><span> 数组），通过 DeepSeek API<span> 进行语义评分。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>8.2 核心指标</span></h3>
<h4><span>数据规模与格式</span></h4>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>指标</span></th><th><span>计算方式</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>格式正确率</span></td>
<td><code>有效解析数 / 总样本数</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>平均测试点数</span></td>
<td><code>总测试点数 / 总样本数</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>生成/标准比例</span></td>
<td><code>生成总数 / 标准总数</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h4><span>语义质量（样本级）</span></h4>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>指标</span></th><th><span>计算方式</span></th><th><span>阈值</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>平均相似度</span></td>
<td><span>所有样本 DeepSeek 评分的均值</span></td>
<td><span>—</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>采纳率</span></td>
<td><code>得分 ≥ 80 的样本数 / 总样本数</code></td>
<td>80分</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h4><span>召回率与准确率（测试点级）</span></h4>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>指标</span></th><th><span>计算方式</span></th><th><span>含义</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>召回率</td>
<td><code>匹配成功数 / 标准测试点总数</code></td>
<td><span>标准测试点被覆盖的比例</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>准确率</td>
<td><code>匹配成功数 / 生成测试点总数</code></td>
<td><span>生成测试点中有效的比例</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>F1</td>
<td><code>2 × P × R / (P + R)</code></td>
<td><span>综合平衡指标</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h4><span>隐藏需求检测</span></h4>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过关键词匹配检测模型是否识别隐含约束：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre>关键词: 权限、安全、兼容、性能、异常、边界、并发、超时、加密、解密、日志、缓存、隔离、容错</pre>
</div>
<h3><span>8.3 综合评级标准</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<pre><span class="token comment"># 针对测试用例生成任务（低温度，高精度）
<span class="token keyword">if precision <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.9 <span class="token keyword">and recall <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.65 <span class="token keyword">and adoption_rate <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.8<span class="token punctuation">:
    ⭐⭐⭐ 优秀：可直接部署
<span class="token keyword">elif precision <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.8 <span class="token keyword">and recall <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.5 <span class="token keyword">and adoption_rate <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.7<span class="token punctuation">:
    ⭐⭐ 良好：基本可用，可优化
<span class="token keyword">elif precision <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.7 <span class="token keyword">and recall <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token number">0.35<span class="token punctuation">:
    ⭐ 一般：需要改进
<span class="token keyword">else<span class="token punctuation">:
    ❌ 需改进：重新评估策略<br>以上评级标准基于本项目业务场景（测试用例生成）设定，供参考。<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>九</span><span>、常见问题与避坑指南</span></h2>
<h3><span>9.1 vLLM 启动失败</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">现象<span>：<code>ValueError: Model architectures [...] are not supported</code></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">原因<span>：vLLM 版本与 Transformers 版本不兼容。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">解决<span>：改用 Transformers 直接推理（稳定，虽然慢但兼容性好）。</span></p>
<h3><span>9.2 磁盘空间不足</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">现象<span>：系统盘 100%，容器异常。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">解决<span>：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>将 <code>MODELSCOPE_CACHE</code><span> 和 <code>HF_HOME</code><span> 指向数据盘。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>定期清理 <code>~/.cache</code><span>。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>9.3 显存不足（OOM）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">解决<span>：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>降低 <code>per_device_train_batch_size</code><span>（从 4 降到 2 或 1）</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>降低 <code>max_length</code><span>（从 2048 降到 1024）</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>启用 <code>bf16</code><span> 或 <code>fp16</code></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>9.4</span><span style="font-size: 1.17em">&nbsp;所有测试点都被标为 false</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">原因<span>：生成内容与标准答案格式差异巨大（如自然语言 vs JSON）。</span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">解决<span>：</span></p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 Prompt 中强制要求 JSON 格式输出</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">关闭思考模式</p>
</li>
<li>增加上下文长度</li>
</ol>
<h2><span>十、总结</span></h2>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>阶段</span></th><th><span>核心动作</span></th><th><span>关键产出</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>阶段0（数据准备）</td>
<td><span>9:1 拆分，格式化为 messages</span></td>
<td><code>sft_train.json</code><span> + <code>dev.json</code></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>阶段1（SFT）</td>
<td><span>1 轮 LoRA 微调</span></td>
<td><span>SFT 模型（checkpoint-134）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>阶段2（动态打标）</td>
<td><span>高温生成 + 评分打标</span></td>
<td><span>KTO 数据（含 label）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>阶段3（KTO）</td>
<td>
<div class="lake-content"><span class="ne-text">undesirable_weight=1.2+</span></div>
<span>2 轮训练</span></td>
<td><span>KTO 最终模型</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>阶段4（推理）</td>
<td><span>Transformers/vLLM 生成</span></td>
<td><code>generated.jsonl</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>阶段5（评测）</td>
<td><span>DeepSeek 语义评分 + 贪心匹配</span></td>
<td><span>评测报告（召回率/准确率/F1）</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">核心心法<span>：小数据集 = 防过拟合 + 强制挖负样本 + 加大奖惩。跑通全流程后，86% 的采纳率证明这套方案完全可行！🚀</span></p>
</blockquote>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ds-flex _0a3d93b">&nbsp;</div>
